notes.title: My Last Memories About You release!
notes.content:
Due to the state of the game, it is unnecessary to wait until the 1st of February, as it is in a complete and fully playable state. Only minor bug fixes and localization updates could be expected in the near future.

Check out the trailer if you haven't seen it:
[previewyoutube=CaxAttgiQt4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

And wishlist it if you haven't done it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504260/My_Last_Memories_About_You/
